name: Neon Pulse Distortion
description: Blackbody plasma cell array where each cell owns one of the eight FFT bins driving its base temperature and flicker rate. Cell temperature is carried through dataTextureC and relaxed with a Stefan-Boltzmann-style T^4 cooling term, so filaments heat fast under the cursor and cool slowly. Fixes a shader catalogued as mouse-driven that never read the mouse (zoom_config appeared only in the struct declaration), an 8x8 workgroup, a depth clobber, and unbounded additive HDR written with an out-of-range alpha.

updatedParams.name: Grid Density
updatedParams.description: Number of plasma cells across the frame (maps to zoom_params.x).

updatedParams.name: Base Temperature
updatedParams.description: Cell base temperature in Kelvin, 800-12000 K (maps to zoom_params.y).

updatedParams.name: Audio Heat Gain
updatedParams.description: How much spectrum energy adds to cell temperature (maps to zoom_params.z).

updatedParams.name: Glow Width
updatedParams.description: Gaussian hotspot sigma; hotter cells glow wider (maps to zoom_params.w).
